lines.en: My tail drives me, pressing the water aside.
I glide along the seabed.
My dorsal fin cuts the current.

lines.zh: 我贴着沉船的龙骨绕行。
lines.en: I glide along the wreck's keel.
I approach slowly from the dark.
I swim your way.
I rise up from the deep.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时身体弯成一张弓。
lines.en: My body bows into the turn.
I swim past the reef.
I close in silently.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾就滑很远。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me far.
I slowly bring my body level.
I sweep over the cliff face.
I rise a stretch toward the surface.
I ride the current.
I narrow the gap bit by bit.
I hang in the water, nearly still.
My teeth show pale underwater.

lines.zh: 我在等一个游动的影子。
lines.en: I wait for a shadow that swims.
I sway my tail to hold position.
My eyes are black and cold.
I draw my body into a line.

lines.zh: 我在听水里很远的响动。
lines.en: I listen to sounds far off.
I make no sound; the water knows.
I patrol this stretch of water.
My gills open and close.
I lift my head slightly.
I wait for the water to cloud.
I hold still like a reef.
My tail sways once, slowly.
I raise my eyes from the water.
My mouth is full of teeth.
I fix on where you stand.
You are smaller than I expected.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把一只黑眼对着你。
lines.en: I roll onto my side and fix one black eye on you.
I rise just under the surface.

lines.zh: 我把上颚松开，让你看清牙。
lines.en: I unhinge my jaw so you can see every tooth.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了一片水。
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of water.
No hurry; I have found you.
I swim along the bank at your feet.
My course slips off.
My fin stiffens for an instant.
A dark red blooms in the water.
I sink down and hide.
I flick my tail and pull away.
My jaws clamp shut.
I fix on you, colder still.
I veer off for a new angle.
I let out no sound at all.
I rise another block.
I finish a full circle around it.
I take it in one clean bite.
That will not fill one gap in my teeth.
I prefer things that move.
I swallow it down.
I lift my head for the next.
I glance and sink away.
I push it to the surface.
I drag it deeper.
I bite it into two.
You hit me and are thrown far.
My body is harder than wood.

lines.zh: 我从你脚下的水面划过。
lines.en: I sweep the surface under your feet.
We throw up a sheet of water.
I barely veer off course.
A boat hits me and rocks hard.
I swing around and come back.
My tail catches you.

lines.zh: 我被顶得横移了半条身长。
lines.en: The shove slides me half a body sideways.
I straighten up and swim on.

lines.zh: 两条巨大的影子一起游。
lines.en: Two vast shadows swim together.
Our fins nearly touch.
It sweeps halfway around me.
We rise to the surface together.
Our tails beat in unison.
It swims level at my flank.
We sink back to the deep together.
Neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在水底叠着。
lines.en: Our shadows lie together on the bottom.
We swim off past the reef together.
I bite into the hull's rim.
I fling it into the air.
I drag it down with me.
It cracks apart in my jaws.
I push it into the shallows.
I look and let go.

lines.zh: 我把它连船帮一起扯下来。
lines.en: I tear it off along with the gunwale.
I swim a circle with it.
It hangs on my teeth.
I drop it on the reef.
I halt and turn slowly.
The taste of the current changed.
I begin accelerating your way.
I open my mouth a little.
My body draws straight.
This water is mine.
I have your position locked.
All my fins are spread.
I press toward the bank.
I am loading this charge.

lines.zh: 我认出了水面上的影子。
lines.en: I recognize the shadow above.
I begin surging upward.
I follow beneath your hull.
Wherever you row, I am underneath.
I circle from the deep.
Each pass brings me closer.
My fin slices the skin of the water.
You hear one muffled knock.
I have not surfaced once.
I press the water your way.
You look back and see only ripples.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几个方向。
lines.en: I count your remaining directions.
I come up from downstream.
I trail your stern.
I hold in the darkest water.
I bite into the hull's side.
I leap from the water into you.
I shake my head and rip the boards free.
My tail cracks the surface.
You are knocked down into the water.
I bite, release, and bite again.
I drag you deeper.
My teeth close beside you.
You grip the planks; I am still here.

lines.zh: 这一撞把船撞出一条缝。
lines.en: The blow opens a seam in the hull.
I strike up from below.
Water floods your mouth and nose.
The surface sinks in one place.
A long shadow rises from the deep.
The water pressure turns heavy.
Every fish by the bank scatters.
I swim out from behind the wreck.
My fin cuts the surface first.
You hear a great breath.
This stretch of sea falls silent.
A track crosses the seabed.
I begin patrolling these waters.
Something pushes the surface up.
I come slowly into view.
The water by your feet grows deeper.
Spray reaches all the way to the bank.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我沉下去避开。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and I sink away.

lines.zh: 我被抛出水面，砸回来很响。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water and crash back.
I choke on the water.
The blast bursts and rolls me over.
A bolt sinks into my spine.
That force pins me down.
Hunger slows my swimming.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水咬进我的脊骨。
lines.en: The lightning bites down my spine through the water.
The sea is gone; I fall and fall.
